QuestInfo.name: Destroying the Energy Conducting Device
QuestInfo.0: A mission taking place at the Power Plant, the hideout of the Black Wings, is about to begin. Talk to #b#p2151001#, the Battle Mage Job Instructor#k to hear the details of the mission.
QuestInfo.1:
Energy from the power plant is being rerouted by the Black Wings from Edelstein to somewhere else. Your mission is to destroy the #r#o9001032##k. The plan is as follows:

1. Sneak into the mine disguised as a Black Wing. 
2. Enter the generator room in #b#m310050100##k.
3. Get rid of #r#o9001032##k and return.

It's not an easy task but it's not impossible if the plan is followed step by step. All right, it's go-time.

#o9001032##r #a230331##k

* If you fail to proceed with the quest, forfeit and start over.
QuestInfo.2: You destroyed the #o9001032#! #p2151001# was thrilled and said that your work will alleviate much of the town's energy problems. He said that you proved yourself capable of using stronger skills and gave you a Job Advancement.

0.0: Okay, ready now? This mission is...complicated. You know the Power Plant and the Mine outside town? They rightfully belong to the citizens of Edelstein, but the Black Wings have taken them as their own. We can't even enter anymore.
0.1: No one knew what the Black Wings were up to. Now it's too late. They've blocked access to the Power Plant, and re-directed the energy there. It wasn't until the random blackouts started that we realized what was going on.
0.2: The Black Wings have built a huge #r#o9001032##k at the Power Plant to transfer the town's energy elsewhere. I don't know why, but I'm sure it's not for a good cause.
0.3: I'm sure you can piece together your mission. Head to the #bPower Room at the Power Plant#k and destroy the #o9001032#. You won't have much time to destroy it and you won't get any back -up support. Do you know why?
0.4: Because the Power Plant is essential for the livelihood of Edelstein. So we must minimize the chance of it getting damaged. Furthermore, if the Power Plant were to explode, it would wipe out all of Edelstein, too...
0.5: Yes, the Black Wings knew what they were doing. They're holding us hostage with our own Power Plant. They'll blow up the town if we don't do exactly as they say. That's why the council president had no choice but to give the Black Wings full control of Edelstein.
0.6: This mission is one of the most difficult you will ever receive as a member of the Resistance, so back out now if you don't think you can do it. The well-being of the entire town is on your shoulders. What do you say?

yes.0: Now, the Power Plant will be crawling with Black Wings. It will not be easy to infiltrate, but you must find a way. I believe Stephan may be able to help you. Try to find a way to #bdisguise yourself as a Black Wing.#k
yes.1: #bDisguise yourself as a Black Wing to gain access to the Power Room and destroy the #o9001032#, all with a limited amount of time.#k It is as difficult as it sounds, but I believe in you. I await your return.\r\n#e#r(If you accept, you'll travel to the quest map automatically.)#k#n

no.0: Remember why the Resistance was created and look within you for the courage to do this mission...

mob.0: You haven't destroyed the #r#o9001032##k yet? I'm not expecting any miracles, but you've got to try! You should review the plan again from the beginning. \r\n\r\n#b* If you fail to proceed with the quest, forfeit and start over.
